cohort: 200 patients who underwent a trial of scar after a previous cesarean section at Nawaz Shareef Social Security Hospital between March 1, 2017 and September 30, 2017, divided into two groups: those with a history of previous vaginal birth and those without.
finding: Patients with a previous vaginal birth had a significantly higher rate of successful VBAC (76%) compared to those without a prior vaginal birth (34%).
